steps.description: Filter genes with >=10 counts in >=3 samples; set explicit factor reference levels (condition and time as factors, t0 reference); median-of-ratios size factors; fit DESeq2 with full ~ condition + time + condition:time and LRT against reduced ~ condition + time (test choice follows time-course rule R-0014; the Wald default warning was reviewed and LRT is correct for a multi-coefficient interaction). Extract per-timepoint interaction contrasts (condition:time t1..t3 vs t0), shrink with ashr (contrast, not single coefficient), BH with independent filtering at alpha 0.05 within each contrast, inspect p-value histogram, report Cook's-distance NA genes.
acceptance_criteria: n_tested after filter reported; LRT padj<0.05 gene list with unshrunken LFC, ashr-shrunken LFC per contrast, and lfcSE
Per-timepoint interaction contrasts (condition:time at t1, t2, t3 vs t0) extracted with shrunk LFC
Counts of genes with NA padj from Cook's outlier flagging reported separately from independent-filtering NAs
Counts.csv carries gene symbols; note as a caveat that no transcript-level quantifications exist, so no tximport length offset is applied

plan.title: Treatment-specific time-course DE via DESeq2 LRT
plan.analytical_narrative: The question is which genes change over time differently between the two conditions beyond the shared time trend — exactly the condition:time interaction. With 24 samples (2 conditions x 4 time points t0..t3, 3 replicates each) and gene-level Salmon counts (12,000 genes), the plan fits a DESeq2 negative-binomial model with full design ~ condition + time + condition:time and tests the interaction by likelihood ratio test against the reduced ~ condition + time model. Low counts are pre-filtered minimally (>=10 counts in >=3 samples) and the DESeq2 independent filter handles the rest; BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering controls FDR within the contrast. Because 3 replicates per cell is a low-power design, the report states the expected power and no threshold is loosened. Significant interaction genes get per-timepoint interaction contrasts with ashr shrinkage and are clustered by trajectory; over-representation against the tested-gene universe with the provisioned WikiPathways human GMT annotates the biology.
